sn4.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati Himavantapadese arañña-kuṭikāyaṃ || || 2.
sn4.20:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn4.20:1.3: sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocayaṃ dhammenā ti || || 3.
sn4.20:2.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn4.20:2.2: Kāretu bhante Bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu Sugato rajjaṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenā ti || || 4.
sn4.20:2.3: Kiṃ pana tvaṃ pāpima passasi yam maṃ tvam evaṃ vadesi || ||
sn4.20:2.4: kāretu bhante Bhagavā rajjaṃ kāretu Sugato rajjaṃ || pe || dhammenā ti || || 5.
sn4.20:2.5: Bhagavatā kho bhante cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā ||
sn4.20:2.6: ākaṅkhamāno ca pana bhante Bhagavā Himavantam pabbatarājaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ tveva adhimucceyya || suvaṇṇañca pabbatassāti || || 6.
sn4.20:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
